dietary_eligibility: Dairy-free holds because there is no dairy, and the dish is not plant or gluten-free because of the fish and regular soy sauce.
allergens: Finfish, soy, and wheat are named from the white fish and regular soy sauce; sesame, egg, and dairy are not in the recipe.
image_observation: Master and card show one opened foil packet on a dinner plate with an opaque uncrusted white fillet, pale ginger coins, scallion rings, halved green bok choy, and a small pool of pale soy-tinted juice, plus a serving of plain white rice that still reads at card size. No lemon, sesame, sear, or breading.
